pools.reason: Same pair, lower fee-tier contrast; not selected by stress outcome

tick_scope.criterion: All initialized ticks within registered tick-space band around historical current tick, approximately half to twice price
tick_scope.rounding: ceil lower usable tick, floor upper usable tick; clamp legal [-887272,887272]
tick_scope.coverage: Every bitmap word intersecting band and every initialized tick in band; no tick-count truncation

borrower_sample.selection: First8 distinct onBehalfOf addresses ranked by SHA256(chain_id:lowercase_address) from complete Borrow-log window ending at each registered block; keep zero-debt accounts, no replacement based on HF, eMode or stress
borrower_sample.portfolio_scope: All historical Aave reserve assets; no WETH/USDC-only HF approximation
borrower_sample.missing: Any missing active-portfolio dependency blocks HF, never zero filled

gates.portfolio_base_tolerance: max(1, participating reserve count) raw base units
gates.oracle_timestamp: 0 < updatedAt <= registered block timestamp; no unstated heartbeat freshness threshold
gates.round_lookup: getRoundData(observed roundId) at same historical block when interface supported
gates.independent_archive: Require successful same-method historical reads AND request-level distinct-backend evidence; endpoint-name equality insufficient
gates.tick_liquidity: No duplicate ticks; gross >= abs(net); initialized bits match; contiguous required bitmap words; anchored liquidity nonnegative; external boundary not independently proven

provider_probe.result: dRPC batch>3 not allowed; Llama403; BlockPI/PublicNode historical state unavailable; no independent backend proof

transport_adaptation: Reduce dRPC batch from max40 to observed limit3; no sample/range/HF-outcome selection change, no paid service

hf_reconstruction.weighted_lt: Per-asset LT, historical user eMode bitmap/config override when supported
hf_reconstruction.scope: Independent full-portfolio economic reconstruction compared against contract; not a formal historical bytecode replica; differences retained and not retuned
